author: Notalgicular
body:
Personally, I think it is ludicrous how someone can get past 1 page of infractions without being banned. People are warned / kicked to make sure they don't do whatever they did wrong again and if they do it again they are banned. People get kicked multiples times in a row for the same thing meaning they KNOW it is wrong yet continue doing it.
I think you Devs need to implement a /l command which lists a players infractions. 
Chat related:
If someone is spamming and have no chat related infractions, warn them either verbally or with /warn.
If they continue, kick them (Or if someone is doing it who already has a warn from a different occasion, kick them too.)
Next time you see someone spamming and /l them before dealing a punishment, if they already have a kick then you tempban, and then a perm if they persist furthermore.
Team Grief:
1st: Kick
2nd: Tempban
3rd: Perm.
Obviously for hacking, it would be instant perm.
tl;dr
I think the punishment system is way to lenient, and staff need an actual structure of punishing people.
Opinions?
